body:
## Goal
Research and implement a modern redesign of the application interface while preserving every existing feature.

## Must-have requirements
- Research and implement an appropriate modern design.
- Make the interface properly responsive.
- Make the interface and map usable on mobile with touch controls.
- Give the map the main share of the screen, especially on mobile.
- Keep all existing features.

## Considerations
- Consider replacing drag-and-drop map editing with a tool-selection approach.
- Evaluate whether Nuxt UI is a good fit for the revamp.
- Consider displaying placeable objects as compact icons with tooltips.
- The sidebar, toolbar, and header can be replaced or removed in favor of better ways to present and edit information.
- Consider prototyping different interface directions.

## Light and dark mode

Add a light/dark preference as part of the interface revamp, without dropping any existing requirements above.

### Requirements
- Provide an explicit light/dark control and remember the user's choice locally.
- Consider using the operating-system preference as the initial default when no explicit choice has been saved.
- Apply the selected palette consistently to both interface and map: backgrounds, panels, dialogs, grid, objects, routes, orbit lines, labels, selection and focus indicators.
- Maintain accessible contrast and visible hover/focus/selected/error states in both modes. Do not rely on color alone to convey important status.
- Replace hard-coded dark panel backgrounds where necessary; reuse the existing CSS variables rather than introduce an elaborate theme engine.
- Keep SVG/PNG exports readable in either theme. Consider an explicit light export for printing, independently of the active interface preference.

### Acceptance criteria
- [ ] The user can switch between light and dark mode without losing edits, selection or map placement.
- [ ] The explicit preference survives reload.
- [ ] Both cluster and system maps, overlays, tooltips and dialogs are consistently styled and readable.
- [ ] Keyboard focus, selected objects and save/error indicators remain distinguishable in both modes.
- [ ] SVG and PNG exports have appropriate contrast and do not contain unreadable labels or unexpected dark-only panels.
